Resolves #19523

The 13.2 notes' seven wide frames now take `width="100%"`, so they fill the Portal's release column at every width instead of scrolling inside their image box. The Portal never scales a Markdown image (the `#8479` design), and the column is 619 px at 1024, 711 at 1366 and 785 at 1440. The 760 px width from #19517 therefore overflowed below about 1415 px. D4 keeps `width="360"`, and captions and alt texts are unchanged.

Evidence: L3 (the actual 13.2 notes rendered in the local Portal at four viewports, measured per image box) → L3 required (AC-2). No residual.

Micro-review eligible: docs-only. It changes one attribute on seven `<img>` lines.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The diff: seven `width="760"` → `width="100%"`, D4 untouched. The release-note link scan (`getDisallowedReleaseNoteGithubLinks`) finds none, and `marked` emits the eight `<img>`, each followed by its caption. |
| AC-2 | Local Portal, `#/news/releases/13.2.0`. Every box has `scrollWidth == clientWidth` and all eight images load; per viewport the wide frames fill: 1024 → 619 px, 1366 → 711, 1440 → 785, 1920 → 1104. D4 stays 360 throughout. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
- **Portal render:** `neo-dev-server` on this branch, with the releases index regenerated locally (`node buildScripts/docs/index/release.mjs -r .github/RELEASE_NOTES`, then restored; the index is a release-time artifact). Before the change, the same view's column measured 711 px at 1366 and 619 at 1024 against 760 px frames.
- **Local setup note:** the Portal's release view needs `dist/marked.mjs` (`node buildScripts/build/marked.mjs`); without it the view's module import fails.
